changelog:
- Initial release of openclaw-ppt-generator.
- Generate PowerPoint (.pptx) files locally using the open source python-pptx library.
- Does not require third-party API calls or API keys.
- Supports slide content with titles, text, and bullet lists.
- Simple command-line usage with flexible content formatting options.
- Returns the file path of the generated PPT.
summary: Generate PPT documents using Python and python-pptx. No third-party API calls, fully open source.
